title: Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf 8.75-Inch Solid Brass | Brushed Bronze | Covered Wall-Mounted Toilet Paper Holder | Glass Shelves | Allied Brass
description:
Keep your bathroom organized while keeping toilet tissue protected with this wall-mounted toilet paper holder (also called a tissue holder or toilet roll holder) that includes a glass shelf above the roll in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Clean install appearance: concealed screw mounting hardware creates a finished look
- Space-saving setup: wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging style keeps surfaces clear
- Coordinate your bath: designed to match the Glass Shelves collection for a cohesive set of versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: toilet paper holder / toilet paper holder with shelf / tissue holder
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8.75 x 4.6 x 6 inches
- Construction: solid brass hardware (brass construction) with glass shelf
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted; concealed screw mounting hardware
multiple designer finish options available (28 finishes)
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Box dimensions: 18 x 12 x 6 inches
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
